questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Assertion: A test cross helps determine an unknown dominant phenotype genotype. Reason: The individual is crossed with a homozygous recessive partner.
options: Both true; Reason does not explain Assertion
questions.solution: A test cross uses a homozygous recessive partner so offspring reveal the unknown genotype.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Two resistors 6 ohm and 3 ohm are connected in parallel across 12 V. Total current is:
questions.solution: Equivalent resistance is 2 ohm, so I=12/2=6 A.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which are correct? I. NH3 is pyramidal. II. BF3 is planar. III. CH4 is bent.
questions.solution: NH3 is trigonal pyramidal, BF3 trigonal planar and CH4 tetrahedral.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A particle starts from rest with acceleration 2 m/s². Displacement in the fifth second is:
questions.solution: Distance in nth second = u + a(2n-1)/2 = 9 m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: For square matrices A and B: I. det(AB)=det(A)det(B). II. det(A+B)=det(A)+det(B) always.
questions.solution: Determinants are multiplicative, but determinant of a sum is not generally additive.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Consider the following statements about human circulation: (I) The pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood away from the heart. (II) The pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood toward the heart. Which is correct?
options: Both I and II are correct
questions.solution: Both statements are correct: the pulmonary artery goes from the right ventricle to the lungs, while pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood to the left atrium.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Assertion: Ribosomes are called the protein factories of the cell. Reason: Ribosomes provide the site where amino acids are assembled into polypeptide chains.
options: Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason correctly explains Assertion
Both are true, but Reason does not explain Assertion
Assertion is true, Reason is false
Assertion is false, Reason is true
questions.solution: Both are true, and the reason directly explains why ribosomes are called protein factories.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which statements are correct? (I) A sigma bond is formed by effective head-on overlap. (II) A pi bond is formed by lateral overlap of orbitals. (III) Free rotation around a double bond is generally restricted.
questions.solution: All three statements are correct. Sigma bonds arise from head-on overlap; pi bonds from lateral overlap, and a double bond restricts rotation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A 6 ohm resistor is connected across a 12 V ideal battery. What current flows through the resistor?
questions.solution: Using Ohm's law, I = V/R = 12/6 = 2 A.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: In a monohybrid cross between two heterozygous individuals, what is the expected phenotypic ratio when complete dominance operates?
questions.solution: A cross Aa × Aa gives genotypes 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa and, under complete dominance, phenotypes 3 dominant : 1 recessive.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A particle moves with constant acceleration. Which statements are necessarily true? (I) Its velocity changes uniformly with time. (II) Its displacement-time graph must be a straight line. (III) Its velocity-time graph is a straight line.
questions.solution: With constant acceleration, velocity varies linearly with time and the velocity-time graph is a straight line. Displacement varies quadratically in general.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: How many moles of water are present in 18 g of H2O?
questions.solution: Molar mass of H2O is 18 g mol−1, so 18 g corresponds to 1 mol.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If the roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0 are α and β, what is α + β?
questions.solution: For ax²+bx+c=0, sum of roots is −b/a. Hence α+β=5.
